title: Settings
description: Manage your identity, calling preferences, privacy, notifications, and display.

errors.webhook: Could not load or save the webhook. {{code}}

account.title: Account and identity
account.detail: Your SparkCall identity is separate from your login session.
account.temporaryNumber: Temporary accounts use an automatically generated number and cannot claim a custom number.
account.numberCooldown: Numbers are case-sensitive. You can change your number once every 30 days.
account.upgradeDetail: Create a permanent username and password while preserving this identity and its eligible data.
account.upgradeSaved: Your temporary identity is now a permanent account. Existing contacts and call records remain on this identity.

audio.title: Audio
audio.detail: Settings are persisted and used on future calls. Actual audio bitrate can vary with network conditions and codec behavior.
audio.speaker: Speaker
audio.devicesDetail: Device names appear after you grant microphone access. Speaker switching depends on browser support.
audio.forceTurnDetail: Use relay candidates only; this disables direct/P2P paths for new calls. Shared Cloudflare Realtime TURN quota applies; after the free allowance, usage is $0.05/GB.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.detail: Call audio is not recorded. Blocking and incoming-call settings are enforced by the server.
privacy.allowIncomingDetail: Declined calls are rejected before WebRTC setup.
privacy.showOnlineStatusDetail: Controls whether presence may be shared by future public-facing features.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.detail: These controls apply only to this browser. Keep SparkCall open and connected to receive missed-call notifications; closed-tab push is not available.
notifications.doNotDisturb: Silence incoming calls on this browser
notifications.doNotDisturbDetail: Incoming call pop-ups are hidden, not declined. Calls remain in your missed-call history. Other devices and configured webhooks are unaffected.
notifications.missedCallsDetail: Show a generic browser notification for new missed incoming calls. Caller names and numbers are not shown.
notifications.missedBody: You have a missed incoming call.
notifications.permissionDenied: Browser notification permission was not granted. Allow notifications for this site in your browser settings, then try again.
notifications.unsupported: This browser does not support native notifications.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.detail: Choose light, dark, or follow your system preference.

usage.title: TURN usage
usage.detail: Monthly relay usage from Cloudflare Realtime analytics. Sampled analytics may not equal final billing data.
usage.unavailable: Usage reporting is not configured or the analytics service returned no data. Calls can still work when TURN credentials are configured.
usage.platformDetail: Aggregate values are sampled estimates, not authoritative billing totals.

notes.Cloudflare Realtime Analytics is sampled: Cloudflare Realtime Analytics is sampled and time-windowed; this dashboard is an estimate, not exact real-time billing data. TURN billing measures egress bytes.

webhook.title: Incoming-call webhook
webhook.detail: Optionally notify your HTTPS endpoint when a call arrives.
webhook.privacy: Only the minimum event data needed for an incoming-call notification is sent. The saved URL is never shown here.
webhook.events: HTTPS GET includes only the event type, call reference, and timestamp—not the caller number, audio, or credentials. The receiver or an intermediary proxy may log query parameters.
webhook.cost: DNS is checked when you save and when delivery runs, but Workers cannot pin arbitrary external DNS to the connection. Configure only a trusted public HTTPS endpoint; delivery may incur provider or network charges.
webhook.replaceDetail: Entering a new URL replaces the current endpoint; the field is always blank.
webhook.confirmRemove: Remove this webhook? Future incoming-call notifications will stop.
